criteria: Historical individuals and ancient beings whose actions shape present-day lore.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Belyi Tsar
items.notes: Monomakh Snezhnyi, the first God of Love and Cryo Archon (2,000-500 years ago) and White Emperor of the Pale Star Court. Born from the Cryo Dragon's remains; killed in the Cataclysm. Guarded the Third Descender's seal.

items.name: Egeria
items.notes: First Hydro Archon / God of Justice (2,000-500 years ago), took over after Remuria's fall; died at Tunigi Hollow during the cataclysm, her body became the Amrita (ties to Sumeru). Created the Oceanids' and Fontainians' primordial-water problem. Mentioned before 4.0; first mention version not verified.

items.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
items.notes: Previous Dendro Archon (Queen Aranyani to the Aranara) and avatar of Irminsul. Died 500 years ago and erased herself from memory. Wiki category gives 3.2 because she first appeared on screen then.

items.name: Guizhong
items.notes: Haagentus, God of Dust; co-led the Guili Assembly with Morax and Marchosius. Killed in the Archon War. Inspiration for Ganyu's and Zhongli's lore and the Guizhong Ballista.

items.name: Irmin
items.notes: Real name Irminsul; last (one-eyed) Vinster King of the Eclipse Dynasty; used 'secrets from beyond the skies'; had the sibling absorb Abyssal power; died 500 years ago.

items.name: King Deshret
items.notes: Al-Ahmar (divine name Amun), Lord of Deserts and one of the Three Eternal Companion-Gods. Central to Sumeru Chapter III and the 6.6 Acts IX-X.

items.name: Makoto
items.notes: Raiden Makoto (Baal). First Electro Archon and Ei's twin. Died in the cataclysm 500 years ago. Her presence is key to the Inazuma Archon Quest and to Ei's story. Wiki category says 2.5 because that is when she first appeared on screen; the twin reveal came in the 2.1 Archon Quest.

items.name: Nibelung
items.notes: Dragon King, Second Descender, true 'Primordial Human'. Created the Three Moons, brought the Abyss/forbidden knowledge into Teyvat; killed by the Heavenly Principles in the war of funerary flame 6,000 years ago.

items.name: Xbalanque
items.notes: First Pyro Archon (divine name Haborym). Led humans to defeat the Pyro Dragon Xiuhcoatl about 2,000 years ago and set the rules by which Natlan's archons are chosen. Returned to the Night Kingdom in As the Blazing Sun (5.3). The 5.0 first mention is assumed.

items.name: Xiuhcoatl
items.notes: Pyro Dragon Sovereign ('Flamelord') of Natlantea, killed by Xbalanque. Created the Thirteen Sovereign Lords, Huitzilopochtli and the Tzitzimimeh. May overlap with the cosmology/dragons scope; dedupe. | Pyro Sovereign (Flamelord), creator of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords; killed by Xbalanque. Gosoythoth mimicked his form.

items.name: Aila
items.notes: First Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions (500 years ago); co-created the Lightkeepers; killed Lovia.

items.name: Alain Guillotin
items.notes: Lord-Artificer, Narzissenkreuz Institute member, Marechaussee Hunter and founding director of the Fontaine Research Institute. Created Sandrone (playable, 7.0) and Pulonia. Earliest appearance version not verified.

items.name: Anacharsis
items.notes: 'Exalted Saint' of Hyperborea, a voyager from the sea of stars (Seutervoinen to the Frostmoon Scions). May overlap the Hyperborea / ancient-civilisations scope. | Voyager from the sea of stars who warned Nibelung of the Abyss; later Exalted Saint of Hyperborea, wife(-host) of Koitar; departed Teyvat. Possibly alive elsewhere - historical by relevance. May overlap Snezhnaya scope.

items.name: Arundolyn
items.notes: 'Lion of Light', Lionfang Knight and Grand Master of the Knights during the cataclysm 500 years ago.

items.name: Avrelian
items.notes: Original 'Reed Miller', founder of the Treasure Hoarders; executed in Snezhnograd 500 years ago.

items.name: Callas
items.notes: Navia's father and boss of the Spina di Rosula. Killed by Clorinde in a trial by combat three years before the story. Recently dead but only mentioned, so typed historical. First mention assumed to be Chapter IV (4.0).

items.name: Crucabena
items.notes: Previous Knave ('Father') of the House of the Hearth, killed by Peruere (= Arlecchino, playable). Shown in Arlecchino's 4.6 quests; the version is assumed from When the Hearth-Flame Goes Out (4.6). Overlaps with the Fatui scope. | Previous Knave (likely also named 'Arlecchino') and former head of the House of the Hearth ('Mother'). Killed by Peruere over a decade ago.

items.name: Decarabian
items.notes: God of Storms, ruler of Old Mondstadt (the tower in Stormterror's Lair), overthrown by Barbatos and the rebels 2,600 years ago.

items.name: Elynas
items.notes: The great beast that is 'father' of the Melusines; its corpse became the Elynas landmass (location.elynas is a separate entity). Appears in the Ancient Colors series (4.0). Overlaps with creature scope; dedupe.

items.name: Filipov
items.notes: Filipov Vseslavyevich, Snowland Fae Grand Duke, first Commander of the Druzhna and the Belyi Tsar's 'Synaimos'.

items.name: I. Ivanovna N.
items.notes: Ioanna Ivanovna N., Hexenzirkel 'J' (Tricksy-Witch); first Mayor of Snezhnograd and Speaker of the Veche. Died 500-400 years ago; Scarlett is her successor.

items.name: Katsuragi
items.notes: Yoriki who befriended the young Scaramouche and was slain by Nagamasa in the Tatarasuna Mystery. Mentioned through Katsuragikiri Nagamasa lore; first mention version estimated.

items.name: Kitsune Saiguu
items.notes: Hakushin kitsune, ally of Ei and Makoto, and Yae Miko's mentor. Died in the cataclysm; the Sacred Sakura is linked to her. Appeared as an event NPC in 5.4.

items.name: Kukulkan
items.notes: Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, the Sage of the Stolen Flame. Dragon Prince who gave phlogiston to humans and served as Regent of Natlantea. Faded in An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty (5.5).

items.name: Lovia
items.notes: Last Archpriestess of Hyperborea and leader of the Frostmoon Scions; stricken from memory for blasphemy.

items.name: Mikoshi Chiyo
items.notes: Oni 'Tiger-Bite' (Torachiyo) of the Mikoshi Clan. Ei's ally, corrupted in the cataclysm. Mother of Iwakura Michihiro and adoptive mother of Nagamasa. Event NPC in 5.4. First lore mention version not verified.

items.name: Mikoshi Nagamasa
items.notes: One of the Yougou Three, later Tatarasuna inspector. Killed Katsuragi in the Tatarasuna Mystery, which ties him to the Scaramouche backstory. Event NPC in 5.4.

items.name: Nabu Malikata
items.notes: Goddess of Flowers, from Celestia, and creator of the Khvarena. Central to the Dirge of Bilqis series. First mention version estimated.

items.name: Nameless Bard
items.notes: The original 'Venti', a boy of Old Mondstadt whose form and name Barbatos took after his death. Disambiguate from character.venti.

items.name: Narzissenkreuz
items.notes: 'The Master', leader of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo and possibly an artificial Oceanid. Made by Rene de Petrichor and Jakob Ingold to merge Fontainians' consciousnesses and avert the apocalypse. Disappeared in Rowboat's Wake (4.2).

items.name: Niwa Hisahide
items.notes: Mikage Furnace officer and Scaramouche's friend. Central to the Tatarasuna Mystery about 400 years ago, in which Dottore was involved. Detailed in the Wanderer's 3.3 quest.

items.name: Och-Kan
items.notes: The Sacred Lord, a half-dragon the Heavenly Principles originally fated to be Pyro Archon. Became the 'insane king' later overthrown by the Scarlet-Eyed Youth. Appears in Lost Traveler in the Ashen Realm (5.2) and passes away in Moment of Awakening (5.2). Ochkanatlan (location) is named after him.

items.name: Orobashi
items.notes: Watatsumi Omikami, the Great Serpent god of Watatsumi and Enkanomiya. Slain by Ei; his remains caused the Tatarigami on Yashiori Island. Could also be filed under cosmology or gods.

items.name: Remus
items.notes: Sebastos / God King of Remuria. Originally from Sumeru and driven out by King Deshret. Created Phobos (the Grand Symphony) to escape the Fortuna prophecy. Featured in the 4.6 Remuria quests; may have been mentioned earlier.

items.name: Rene de Petrichor
items.notes: Founder of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo; dissolved himself and was reborn as Narzissenkreuz. Only mentioned (not an on-screen NPC), so typed historical. Wiki page title is 'Rene'.

items.name: Rostam
items.notes: 'Wolf Pup', Knight of Boreas and Master of the Knights 500 years ago. Created Favonius Bladework and was Rosalyne (La Signora)'s lover. Died in the cataclysm.

items.name: Saarelainen
items.notes: 'Stranger of Winter's Day', the Third Descender. Anastasya's lover and ancestor of the Khaenri'ahns; his body became the seven Gnoses. May overlap cosmology.descenders. | Third Descender, 'Stranger of Winter's Day', lover of Anastasya and ancestor of the Khaenri'ahns; body turned into the seven Gnoses; erased from Irminsul.

items.name: Solovei
items.notes: Silvestr Petrovich Solovei, the first Torchforger and founder of the Lightkeepers; a Snezhnayan noble and Avrelian's childhood friend.

items.name: Tenoch
items.notes: Tenoyollotzin, an exiled Muratan warrior who gathered one warrior from each of six tribes to fight the Abyss during the cataclysm. Eaten by the Bakunawa. Shown in flashback during the 5.x Archon Quest.

items.name: Vennessa
items.notes: Flame-touched Muratan (Natlan-born) gladiator who led the rebellion against the Aristocracy about 1,000 years ago and founded the Knights of Favonius.

items.name: Aberaku
items.notes: Aberaku no Mikoto (Abrax), Enkanomiya sage who built the Dainichi Mikoshi artificial sun and was helped by Istaroth. His preserved memories appear as an NPC.

items.name: Ahpub
items.notes: Chief of the Collective of Plenty and original bearer of Uwezo.

items.name: Alia
items.notes: Aila's twin and the second Reed Miller; sacrificed herself stopping Rauthvangi.

items.name: Alvis
items.notes: Grand Duke of the Domovoy and Lord of Kitezhgrad; recently killed by Aksinya.

items.name: Amber's Grandfather
items.notes: Founder of the Outriders; missing. Arguably present-day (whereabouts unknown) rather than historical.

items.name: Amos
items.notes: Old Mondstadt archer and Decarabian's lover, who joined the rebellion. Namesake of Amos' Bow.

items.name: Andersdotter
items.notes: Anya 'Marie' Andersdotter, Hexenzirkel 'M', author of The Boar Princess, now deceased. She created the Simulanka Durin, who became playable. | Anya 'Marie' Andersdotter, Hexenzirkel 'M' (Story-Witch) and author of The Boar Princess. Died 500-400 years ago. Also Mondstadt.

items.name: Anfortas
items.notes: Knight Marshal of the Schwanenritter, Marshal Regent after Irmin was 'indisposed'; led survivors to Sumeru. Likely Alberich.

items.name: Aria
items.notes: Goddess of the Eternal Moon, eldest Moon Sister; perished after the war of funerary flame.

items.name: Boethius
items.notes: The 'Bleeding Idol', a Harmost of Remus. Appears in Underwater Nocturne (4.6).

items.name: Bonanus
items.notes: General Chizapus, one of the Five Foremost Yakshas (Xiao's 'Hereafter' quest).

items.name: Bosacius
items.notes: Marshal Vritras, leader of the Five Foremost Yakshas; his karma tied to The Chasm.

items.name: Brahe
items.notes: Brahe Prokhorovitch Trubetskoy, the third Reed Miller, a Grand Duke and the last Governor of Nod-Krai after the Cataclysm.

items.name: Burkina
items.notes: 'Turnfire', Scions of the Canopy, cataclysm-era bearer of Malipo. Killed by his Abyss-tainted Yumkasaurus Kongamato, who is now a boss (creature scope).

items.name: Burner of Cities
items.notes: Vila who rebelled against the Tsaritsa's reduction of fae noble privileges.

items.name: Canon
items.notes: Goddess of the Frost Moon (Huurrekuutar to Frostmoon Scions, Prusmene in Arcadia); Frost Moon banished beyond the false sky.

items.name: Cassiodor
items.notes: The Golden Hunter, a Remurian Harmost and founder of the Marechaussee Hunters. Faded away after Fortune Plango Vulnera.

items.name: Clervie
items.notes: Hearth child and Arlecchino's friend; killed by Peruere. Also in the animated short The Song Burning in the Embers. | Crucabena's daughter, raised with Peruere at the House of the Hearth. Killed by Peruere; her death drove Arlecchino's rise. Introduced in the animated short 'The Song Burning in the Embers'.

items.name: Cochanina
items.notes: Ancient Pyro Archon from Meztli who drove off the 'Volcano Lord' and helped contain the Bakunawa. Gosoythoth mimicked her in Where All Hopes Lie (5.3). Other named Pyro Archons have no wiki page (Ndenge, Xumucul, Gloharry, Shulevitz, Isaja, an unnamed female Muratan archon); cover them in the Pyro Archon cosmology entry.

items.name: Cryo Dragon
items.notes: Cryo Sovereign; corpse used by Hyperborea to attempt a Primordial Human, producing the Belyi Tsar (Monomakh Snezhnyi). No known successor.

items.name: Eberhart
items.notes: Illegitimate aristocrat heir of Landrich who schemed against the Aristocracy (weapon lore). Half-brother of Parsifal and Ingbert.

items.name: Emanuel Guillotin
items.notes: Marechaussee Hunter and adoptive father of Alain and Mary-Ann Guillotin. Absorbed by Narzissenkreuz.

items.name: Erinnyes
items.notes: Lochknight and High King of Aremorica who united Fontaine's tribes against Remuria. Erinnyes Forest is named after her (the location is a separate entity).

items.name: Grazina
items.notes: Grazina Myklukho, researcher who created Mandragoras; sealed inside the 'Post-Apocalyptic Elysium'.

items.name: Gunnhildr
items.notes: Gunnhildr clan woman of Decarabian's era who became a devotee of the wind spirit (the future Barbatos); the clan took her name. Distinct from the Knight of the Golden Bough.

items.name: Guthred
items.notes: Khaenri'ahn soldier under Capitano who died in the cataclysm. His soul fought Ororon for control of Ororon's body (Beneath the Secret Source, 5.1).

items.name: Havria
items.notes: Goddess of Salt, killed by her own followers during the Archon War (Salt quests, Yanfei lore).

items.name: Hermanubis
items.notes: 'Greatest of Sages', one of the Seven Pillars, linked to Cyno's General Mahamatra lore. Version estimated.

items.name: Hydro Dragon
items.notes: Original Hydro Sovereign, ruled the Primordial Sea; died after the war against the Heavenly Principles and reincarnated as Neuvillette. Could alternatively be folded into Neuvillette's entry.

items.name: Imunlaukr
items.notes: Outlander in Sal Vindagnyr at its fall and namesake of the Imunlaukr Clan, one of modern Mondstadt's founding clans.

items.name: Indarias
items.notes: General Musatas, one of the Five Foremost Yakshas.

items.name: Iwakura Michihiro
items.notes: Also known as Iwakura Doukei (title Douin); 'Iwakura Doukei' redirects here. Chiyo's son and founder of the Iwakura Clan and the Tengu Sweeper art. Event NPC in 5.4.

items.name: Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon
items.notes: Ixlel, the Chronicler of the End Times, Ninth Sovereign Lord. Appears in Open Your Heart to Me (5.2); the Traveler released her soul.

items.name: Ixquieh
items.notes: Original bearer of Baraka (Children of Echoes) and one of Xbalanque's six original heroes.

items.name: Izmaylov
items.notes: Nikolay 'Pakhan' Izmaylov, a Domovoy, Hvergelmir member and later President of the Royal Energy Commission. Killed by Vasiliy (Mean Streets of the Despicable, 7.0).

items.name: Kaedehara Yoshinori
items.notes: Kazuha's great-grandfather, a victim of the 'Case of the Eccentric' (Scaramouche's revenge on the Raiden Gokaden).

items.name: Kapatcir
items.notes: The Great Thunderbird of Tsurumi Island, slain long ago. Could also be filed as creature/bosses. Thunderbird and Kanna Kapatcir redirect here.

items.name: Kazuha's Friend
items.notes: Tomo (Tomo redirects here). Vision bearer executed after dueling Kujou Sara under the Vision Hunt Decree; his Vision shaped Kazuha's story. Version estimated from Kazuha's release.

items.name: Lianca
items.notes: First Speaker of the Flower-Feather Clan and original bearer of Vuka. Adopted by a Sovereign Lord; died fighting Och-Kan after her son betrayed her. Wielded the Chain Breaker. Voiced in flashback in Searing (5.8).

items.name: Lyris
items.notes: Oceanid who directed the Narzissenkreuz Institute orphanage; 'Red Empress' of the Ordo. Absorbed Mary-Ann Guillotin's consciousness and became the hybrid Mary-Ann.

items.name: Maghan
items.notes: Also called Dinga. Original bearer of Bidii (Masters of the Night-Wind). On Och-Kan's orders he killed his master, the Holy Sovereign.

items.name: Mary-Ann Guillotin
items.notes: Human member of the Narzissenkreuz Institute in the cataclysm era. Her consciousness merged with Lyris. Different from npc.mary-ann (the hybrid Oceanid) and npc.ann.

items.name: Menilek
items.notes: Flower-Feather Clan and cataclysm-era bearer of Vuka, with his Qucusaurus companion Ngoubou.

items.name: Menogias
items.notes: General Kapisas, one of the Five Foremost Yakshas.

items.name: Miscislav
items.notes: 'Blood-Devourer', Volkodlak king of the Miscislavli Alliance; killed by Monomakh at Kitezh 3,000 years ago.

items.name: Mistress of Chenyu Vale
items.notes: Unnamed god of ancient Chizhang who fought Morax and was sealed. Former mistress of Lingyuan, Herblord and Fujin (4.4 Chenyu Vale).

items.name: Ormazd
items.notes: Shah of Gurabad and Liloupar's husband. Version estimated.

items.name: Parvezravan
items.notes: Kisra Parvez, Spirit of Victory, the second-to-last king of Gurabad. Version estimated.

items.name: Phobos
items.notes: The Grand Symphony ('Discordant Symphony') that Remus made to defy fate, created through Sybilla's sacrifice. Destroyed in Fortune Plango Vulnera (4.6). Could also go under item/lore.

items.name: Princess of Sal Vindagnyr
items.notes: Daughter of the high priest Varuch, part of the Dragonspine 'Princess/Priest/Scribe' box lore.

items.name: Prokhor Trubetskoy
items.notes: Snowland Fae Grand Duke and Governor of Nod-Krai before the Cataclysm; Brahe's adoptive father.

items.name: Ragnvindr
items.notes: The Dawn Knight of the Aristocratic period and namesake/ancestor of the Ragnvindr Clan.

items.name: Red-Haired Warrior
items.notes: Key rebel against Decarabian and a friend of the Nameless Bard, Amos and Gunnhildr.

items.name: Roland
items.notes: The Bloodstained (formerly White) Knight, mentored by Rostam, 500 years ago. Has quest appearances.

items.name: Sakkuk
items.notes: 'Peace-Reforger', Chief of the Children of Echoes. First hero to join the Scarlet-Eyed Youth against Och-Kan and the last survivor; erased the youth's name.

items.name: Sanhaj
items.notes: Sanhaj Kompore, Masters of the Night-Wind and cataclysm-era bearer of Bidii. Died detonating a miniature Night Kingdom at Mare Jivari.

items.name: Sasayuri
items.notes: Great Tengu of Yougou. Served the Shogun and was killed in the war against Orobashi's people. Event NPC in 5.4. First mention version estimated.

items.name: Scarlet-Eyed Youth
items.notes: Unnamed second Pyro Archon from Tlalocan (the Flower-Feather Clan). Led the tribes against Och-Kan and asked Sakkuk to erase his name.

items.name: Scylla
items.notes: Fell Dragon Prince from the Remurian era. Appears as an NPC in the Sea of Bygone Eras.

items.name: Simurgh
items.notes: Divine bird who sacrificed herself in the cataclysm, becoming the Khvarena; ancestor of the Pari.

items.name: Sonnet
items.notes: Goddess of the Iridescent Moon; merged its remains with the Abyss, becoming the Crimson Moon over Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon Dynasty; laid to rest by Columbina.

items.name: Sundjatta
items.notes: Nare Magan Sundjatta, 52nd Chief of the Children of Echoes and cataclysm-era bearer of the Ancient Name Baraka.

items.name: Sybilla
items.notes: The Golden Bee, an Angel who was Celestia's envoy in Meropis. She sacrificed herself to create Phobos. | Golden Bee Angel of Meropis/Remuria; probably owned by Fontaine scope.

items.name: Tao Dou
items.notes: Bune, a tree god before the realm of the dead, purified by the Eight Adepts. Linked to Liyue afterlife lore.

items.name: Tholindis
items.notes: Rerir's would-be fiancée, Crimson Moon descendant, Moon Marrow researcher; appears via 'A Nation That Doesn't Exist' (Luna I).

items.name: Tupac
items.notes: People of the Springs giant and cataclysm-era bearer of Umoja. Carried Mavuika to the Sacred Flame and died standing.

items.name: Uenuku
items.notes: Treader of the Rainbow, original bearer of Umoja (People of the Springs).

items.name: Vaselisa von Strivozha
items.notes: 'The Pure One', first Grand Duchess of the Vila and ruler of the Silver Court of Veneter.

items.name: Vautrin
items.notes: Captain of Special Security and Surveillance in the Maison Gardiennage, about 400 years ago. Appears in Ever-Surging Memories / The Remains of the Past Day (4.1); killed Suavegothe and Thibert.

items.name: Wandering Knight
items.notes: First Knight of Boreas, of Vennessa's era; wielded Wolf's Gravestone.

items.name: Wanjiru
items.notes: Collective of Plenty and cataclysm-era bearer of Uwezo, with her Tatankasaurus companion Kayeke.

items.name: Yalyane Morevna
items.notes: 'Knyazhna of Blood', the first Snegurochka and princess of the House of Hesperides.

items.name: Yupanqui
items.notes: The Firethief, original bearer of Malipo (Scions of the Canopy) and companion of Xbalanque. Died fighting Och-Kan.

items.name: Aj Nimalaj Chuq'ab Hun
items.notes: The Valiant One, First of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords (AI rulers created by Xiuhcoatl).

items.name: Akame Kanenaga
items.notes: Akame School smith who helped Scaramouche undermine the Raiden Gokaden.

items.name: Ako Domeki
items.notes: Deathless Oni of Seirai, a pirate who rebelled against the Shogunate about 500 years ago.

items.name: Akuou
items.notes: Touzannou, 'Viceroy of the East', Watatsumi general in the Narukami-Watatsumi War about 2000 years ago. Version estimated.

items.name: Anton Zarkovich Karnatsky
items.notes: Armory Palace kuuvahki researcher in the Nothing Passage (Colors of Emptiness); paired with Preobrazhensky.

items.name: Aradasha
items.notes: Strongest Ararakalari user, who repaired the Varuna Contraption. Version estimated.

items.name: Aramuhukunda
items.notes: Aranara hero who became a Vasara Tree to seal Marana's Avatar.

items.name: Asase Hibiki
items.notes: Seirai shrine maiden and one of the Yougou Three, about 500 years ago. Narrator of Hamayumi.

items.name: Atawallpa
items.notes: Elder twin hero (Meztli) of the war against Och-Kan; brother of Waskar.

items.name: Aurelius
items.notes: One of the four Harmosts of Remuria. Not the same person as other Aurelius pages.

items.name: Ayame
items.notes: Umigozen, Watatsumi warrior of the Narukami-Watatsumi War and Mouun's twin. Version estimated.

items.name: Basil Elton
items.notes: Admiral of the Fontaine Navy (White Armada) and last Vice-Director of the Narzissenkreuz Institute. Died fighting Elynas's beast during the cataclysm.

items.name: Blue-Eyed Spear Witch
items.notes: Sorceress of the Late Aristocracy period, possibly named Josephine.

items.name: Boyang
items.notes: Yelan's ancestor who fell at The Chasm 500 years ago.

items.name: Carter Scherbius
items.notes: Narzissenkreuz alumnus and Alain Guillotin's research assistant.

items.name: Chaac
items.notes: Said to be the first human to receive the primal fire from Kukulkan.

items.name: Chi
items.notes: Serpent god sealed by Morax at what is now Qingce Village; also the name of a type of sea-dragon monster.

items.name: Clementine
items.notes: Navia's mother and Callas's wife; died in childbirth.

items.name: Coppelius
items.notes: Playwright from about 500 years ago; Institute of Natural Philosophy.

items.name: Dawnlight Swordswoman
items.notes: Wanderer's Troupe member and original wielder of The Flute, about 1,000 years ago.

items.name: Dwight Lasker
items.notes: Director of the Institute of Natural Philosophy. Narzissenkreuz Institute alumnus.

items.name: Eduardo Baker
items.notes: Outlaw leader of Fleuve Cendre before the cataclysm; Jakob's father.

items.name: Euergetia
items.notes: One of the four Harmosts of Remuria, called 'the benefactrix'.

items.name: Froderock Fronkonsteen
items.notes: Dottore's subordinate who led the Fatui Desert Expedition in Sumeru; likely killed by Jeht.

items.name: Guhua
items.notes: Mythic martial nomad and namesake of the Guhua Clan (Xingqiu lore).

items.name: Hadura
items.notes: Schwanenritter member, ancestor of Klingsor.

items.name: Hakushin
items.notes: Kitsune matriarch of the Hakushin Clan and ancestor of the Kitsune Saiguu and Yae Miko. Version estimated.

items.name: Han Wu
items.notes: Weaponsmith of the cataclysm era (Prototype and Blackcliff series).

items.name: Hiiragi Hiroshi
items.notes: Kanjou Commissioner about 500 years ago, tied to the kitsune statue lore. Version estimated.

items.name: Maghan's Master
items.notes: Last Holy Sovereign of the tribe that became Mictlan. After death she became that tribe's Wayob; first wielder of Starcaller's Watch. The id slug is a descriptive choice; the wiki has no proper name.

items.name: Huitzilin
items.notes: Masters of the Night-Wind shaman from 200 years ago. Has a voiced/quest role; check its significance during the write-up.

items.name: Ingbert
items.notes: Legitimate heir of Landrich (Aristocracy era).

items.name: Ix Ajkotz'i'j Iq'ismal Waxak
items.notes: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers, Eighth Sovereign Lord and ruler of Ch'upikaq Tajin. Lianca's adoptive mother; executed by vote of the Chamber of Deliberation.

items.name: Ix Je'lal K'ua'l Ka'
items.notes: The Jade Maiden, Second of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords.

items.name: Ix Kemonel Jasjatem Oox
items.notes: The Weaver of Secrets, Third of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords.

items.name: Jacob Musk
items.notes: Ecologist and ancestor of Ella and Edith Musk; hilichurl books.

items.name: Kaedehara Hisamichi
items.notes: Kazuha's grandfather.

items.name: Kaedehara Kageharu
items.notes: Kazuha's father.

items.name: Kamisato Kayo
items.notes: Deceased mother of Ayato and Ayaka.

items.name: Kamuna Harunosuke
items.notes: Onmyouji, one of the Yougou Three, trained by both the adepti and the tengu. Petrified Ioroi. Appears in the Narukami Trail quest.

items.name: Karl Ingold
items.notes: Fontainian figure from 400-500 years ago; connected to Jakob Ingold and Parsifal.

items.name: Kaveh's Father
items.notes: Unnamed Rtawahist scholar whose death shaped Kaveh.

items.name: Kitain Bunsou
items.notes: 'Kitain the Serpent', a Yashiori Island Guardian who subdued the Tatarigami. Version estimated.

items.name: Kitain Hideie
items.notes: Last Prefect of Yashiori, who secretly abandoned his duty during the cataclysm. Version estimated.

items.name: Knight of the Golden Bough
items.notes: An Arcadian exile also named Gunnhildr, described as the namesake of the Gunnhildr Clan (artifact-set lore). Conflicts with the other Gunnhildr origin, so note it as a canon discrepancy.

items.name: Kreuzlied
items.notes: Disowned Lawrence who joined the Wanderer's Troupe and wielded The Bell.

items.name: Kujou Shigeyori
items.notes: Kujou ancestor who built Kujou Encampment in one night. Version estimated.

items.name: Landrich
items.notes: Aristocrat, father of Parsifal, Ingbert and Eberhart.

items.name: Leonard
items.notes: Adventurer of about 2,600 years ago who climbed Pilos Peak; knew Venerare.

items.name: Leticia
items.notes: Leticia Randolph, alias Rosa Reed, wielder of the Verdict claymore. Weapon lore only.

items.name: Luther
items.notes: Author of the Ancient Investigation Journals; servant of Landrich's household.

items.name: Makhaira
items.notes: Queen-Regent of Tulaytullah after Deshret's era (weapon lore). Version estimated.

items.name: Mallko
items.notes: Ancient Name bearer of the Scions of the Canopy who died in a Night Warden War five years ago (Black Stone Under a White Stone, 5.0).

items.name: Marfisa
items.notes: Champion Duelist from more than 500 years ago. Absorbed by Narzissenkreuz.

items.name: Mouun
items.notes: Watatsumi shrine maiden and whalesong master from the Yuna Clan who founded the island's navy. Ayame's twin. Version estimated.

items.name: Nepla Korolevitsna
items.notes: Human warrior before the Archon War; wife of Filipov.

items.name: Nikolay
items.notes: Katarina's brother, a Fatui corporal lost in The Chasm. Recently deceased; could be npc instead.

items.name: Papa Wrench
items.notes: Mr. Shesternin Sr., a deceased Snezhnayan in Nod-Krai; father of Danyusha Shesternin.

items.name: Parsifal
items.notes: Aristocrat heir, the Phantom Thief, who later became the Skipper's Chief Mate in Liyue.

items.name: Parsifal the Great
items.notes: Great Magician of Fleuve Cendre from before the cataclysm. Her sister performed as 'Josephine'.

items.name: Pervases
items.notes: Junior Yaksha who died in the Archon War; appears via the Mortal Lingering ritual.

items.name: Petronilla
items.notes: Clorinde's master, a Champion Duelist ('Protector of Justice'). Mentioned only.

items.name: Pir Kavikavus
items.notes: Kshahrewar genius whose Ruin Golem accident led to the darshan's decline. Version estimated.

items.name: Preobrazhensky
items.notes: Rival researcher of Karnatsky (Colors of Emptiness).

items.name: Priscilla
items.notes: Accomplice of Eberhart during the fall of the Aristocracy.

items.name: Ravenwood
items.notes: Second Knight of Boreas; his greatsword was the model for Ferrous Shadow.

items.name: Reizenbou
items.notes: Yougou tengu, the original wielder of Thundering Pulse. Version estimated.

items.name: Renault de Petrichor
items.notes: De Petrichor family member, killed in the Siege of Poisson. Relative of Rene.

items.name: Rongzhao
items.notes: Yelan's ancestor, driven mad by Bosacius' karma.

items.name: Ruggiero
items.notes: First Doge of Petrichor.

items.name: Sea Gazer
items.notes: Deceased adeptus, owner of the Fantastic Compass.

items.name: Shirin
items.notes: Half-Jinni last queen of Gurabad, daughter of Liloupar and Ormazd. Not the same as the forest ranger NPC 'Shirin'.

items.name: Skipper
items.notes: Liyue captain of about 1,000 years ago who hunted a sea monster; linked to Parsifal.

items.name: Skybracer
items.notes: Adeptus who died in the Archon War; honored at Lantern Rite (1.3).

items.name: Sohreh
items.notes: Amurta Dastur who died in Ardravi Valley research about 400 years ago. Linked to Zandik/Dottore.

items.name: Sojourner
items.notes: Unofficial name for the lyrist traveler of the Resolution of Sojourner artifact lore.

items.name: Suavegothe
items.notes: Old Regime figure killed by Vautrin. Part of the Vautrin quest series.

items.name: Taika
items.notes: Lord Taika of the Flower-Feather Clan; Bona's father. Disappeared searching for the Tonatiuh / Jade of Return.

items.name: Takamine the Mistsplitter
items.notes: Hatamoto martial artist from 500 years ago. Linked to the Mistsplitter and Thundering Pulse lore. Version estimated.

items.name: Ukko
items.notes: Scribe of Sal Vindagnyr's final days (Princess' Box).

items.name: Unnamed Gladiator
items.notes: Eberhart's slave gladiator, subject of Gladiator's Finale.

items.name: Urakusai
items.notes: Kitsune author of the original Chronicles of the Six Kitsune.

items.name: Varuch
items.notes: Likely the last king-priest of Sal Vindagnyr.

items.name: Venerare
items.notes: Early leader of the Lawrence Clan, about 2,600 years ago.

items.name: Viaghara
items.notes: 'True tiger', first lord of the forest under Rukkhadevata. Version estimated.

items.name: Waskar
items.notes: Younger twin hero (Collective of Plenty) who fought the insane king Och-Kan.

items.name: Xiphos
items.notes: 'Blade of Tulaytullah', Makhaira's lover (weapon lore). Version estimated.

items.name: Yelena
items.notes: Fatui deserter whose Delusion caused rapid aging; posed as the scholar 'Vijava' in Fontaine. | Ex-Fatuus 'Vijava', Kirya's sister; created the Auguste perfume in Fontaine; died about 20 years ago.

items.name: Yun Huang
items.notes: Eighth Yun Family head; Blackcliff weapon lore with Han Ce.

items.name: Yun Hui
items.notes: Seventh Yun Family master and Qixing member after the cataclysm; Prototype weapons.

items.name: Zumurud
items.notes: Verdant Lord who ruled desert city-states after Deshret.
